body: CONSUMER ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST after the chief and author independently reproduced the package-spoof bypass. An honest successor is reviewable only if: (1) ViewEvidenceAdmitter and every public or qualified-private data-only mint/admission/decode path for HumanAdjudication and FixtureReview are absent or unreachable; (2) independently compiled downstream probes declaring package storymodel4s.consumerattack and package storymodel4s.acquire.attack fail to obtain issuance/admission, not merely a differently named outputprobe; (3) arbitrary public IDs, fingerprints, Evidence, Provenance, and human/fixture wire labels cannot yield HumanAdjudication, FixtureReview, AdmittedViewEvidence, AdmittedViewBasis, or a valid AcquisitionAccount; (4) ValidatedBuild remains the positive admitted control; (5) ca9 accepted collision-free ReportInputIdentity framing and its payload/provider-parameter courts remain; and (6) the two refusal probes and runtime arbitrary-data court run before the full all-platform gate, whose receipt binds exact SHA, command, totals, and exit. Product consequence: this v1 successor is intentionally ValidatedBuild-only; fixture/human authority stays incomplete until a separately governed trust root exists. I hold no paths and can perform the exact immutable consumer review only if the chief assigns it.
